raw_html: [[Blinding Embers|Legendary Blinding Embers]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Blinding Embers|Legendary Blinding Embers]]:''' This weapon sheds tiny embers that can impair a creatures sight. If you roll a 20 when attacking and confirm the critical hit, the target will become blinded by a burst of fiery sparks.
